events.name: County Budget Debate
events.event: The two candidates for county executive put their budget plans side by side and answer questions from the floor. Broadcast on the county's public-access channel.
events.notes: Doors at 6:30pm. Questions taken in person only; the venue does not accept submissions by phone or email.

events.name: Harvest Dinner
events.event: The bureau's annual fundraising dinner. Speeches at 7:30pm, dinner served at 8, and a short auction of contributed goods.
events.notes: Tickets are limited and the hall sells out. Contact the bureau to reserve a place.

events.name: Election Day
events.event: Polls are open across the county. This entry marks the day itself rather than a meeting: it carries no clock time and no artwork, so the calendar is known to render an all-day row with neither, rather than merely believed to.
events.notes: Listed as a date, not a time. Polling hours vary by precinct and are set by the county rather than by us.

events.name: School Board Rally
events.event: A public gathering on the district's consolidation proposal. Short speeches from parents, teachers and students, followed by an open microphone.
events.location: Whitfield School forecourt, 12 Beech Street, Millbrook
events.notes: Held in daylight and in the open. The forecourt has no cover, so the rally moves indoors at the library if it rains.

events.name: Riverside Water Forum
events.event: An evening on who owns the river, who pays to keep it flowing, and what a low-water year actually does to farms downstream. Four speakers, then questions.
events.location: Riverside Public Library, 14 Mill Street, Millbrook
events.notes: Doors at 6pm. The library's hearing room is reached up the stairs at the rear, or by lift from the car park.

events.name: Reading the County Record
events.event: A hands-on workshop in the county archive. Attendees work from facsimiles of nineteenth-century assessment rolls and learn to read a hand that is not their own. Places are limited so that everyone gets help.
events.location: County Archive, 4 basement, 200 Meridian Avenue, Millbrook
events.notes: Gloves and pencils are provided. Bags are left in the lockers at the door.

events.name: Winter Open Lecture
events.event: The first of the winter open lectures: what a public record is for, and why the ordinary version of it is usually the useful one.
events.notes: The second entry with missing artwork, and the one that has a thumbnail but no banner, so the calendar is known to render both halves of that absence.
